notes.title: Welcome Chaos Crew!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]We’re excited to introduce [b]Space Chaos[/b], our second game, playable with [b]1 to 4 players[/b].
[/p][p]Your mission: inspect and manage the cargo arriving at your space station. Easy? Not really… Between broken systems, suspicious (or alive) shipments, fires to put out, and the vortex sucking up everything in sight, things quickly spiral into chaos.
[/p][p]And of course, space loves to stir the pot: strange anomalies, radioactive cargo, unpredictable alien visitors… you won’t be bored.
[/p][p]The game is still in development, but we’ll be sharing regular updates and gameplay details leading up to Early Access in a few months.
[/p][p]We can’t wait to see how you handle this interstellar mess. Add it to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] and join us on Discord to follow the adventure and chat with the community:
[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/mmnxUpXYcK"]https://discord.gg/mmnxUpXYcK[/url][/p][p][/p]
